pocket.why_this_rank: The compact N strip is coverable and its hydrophobic content suits the supplied heavy ridge, while avoiding C2's largest reach penalty. It remains mostly a nested version of C2 and has the weakest side-chain direction coherence.
pocket.rests_on: The compact N strip is the complete epitope rather than merely the shared core of the broader C2 face.
pocket.what_it_is: The conserved hydrophobic-aromatic N face at the junction between a viral attachment-domain flank and the base of its disulfide loop: an H-F-E-V-F-N-F-V-P-rich strip that forms the gamma1-side approach to the conserved domain.
pocket.why_one_candidate: not pooled with anything: no other patch is both within 12 A (half centroid distance, half contact-graph hops) and coverable by one paratope of this antibody's reach, 17.0 A

note: `confidence` on the pocket is over pockets and sums to about 1 across them. Inside an interface it is per residue in [0, 1] and sums to nothing. No residue is cut at a threshold: the whole vector is the answer.

paratope.heavy_light_split: Heavy-dominant, about 72:28. L1/L3 cap A:7-A:10, both chains share A:9/A:10, and H1/H2/H3 run along A:11-A:21, placing the proline-rich H2/H3 ridge over the conserved hydrophobic strip.

pooling_provenance.note: counts only, describing how the organizer grouped the phase-1 patches. The organizer's own candidate residue list is deliberately absent: the answer is the advocate's footprint, in `residues` and in `antibodies[].interfaces[]`.

advocate.weakest_point: The refined footprint does not directly center the CX3C/WAI receptor motif, so its neutralization mechanism relies on steric adjacency and conformational clamping. Published gamma1-like recognition can extend farther into the noose than A:21, and A:14-A:17 are partly recessed or disulfide-buried. Thus a purely compact N-face interface may be too small or too indirect unless the actual approach angle places the Fab across the receptor path—something separate-structure analysis cannot establish.
advocate.note: the advocate reports claim/source/date/bearing and is not asked whether a source is about this binder

judge.note: Tier A -- a source about this binder itself -- is the judge's adjudication, in assessment[].support[]. It exists nowhere in the advocate's own answer.
